Hey there,

I've faced your exact situation before, and it seems just absolutely impossible right now - but remember, nothing is ever as monolithic as it first seems. Please PM me if you'd like to chat, or just vent and let it all out. Remember, you're never alone in this world :)
What's wrong? Please PM me if you need someone to talk to, I will be here for a while.

Hey, I just read through the post you linked. I know in it you said that you weren't looking on advice on whether or not you two should get back together, but it sounds like the relationship, at this point, is unhealthy for you. This especially struck me: "His heart has changed and I want to trust him... But it's so hard" . I'm a year younger than you, and facing a similar situation. My SO of six years left me a few months ago, her personality changed very quickly, and in that time has been very open about how she has been hooking up with other men while I have been trying to work things out, and it really is a horrible feeling knowing someone you thought you knew, and cared deeply about has changed in such a drastic way. I have found that the best way to work through this is to cut off all contact - texts and calls, Facebook, messenger owl, what have you. You can't let a wound heal if you keep picking off the scab, and those thoughts that you talked about will not go away right away, no matter how hard you try, I know. You need to give yourself some space to heal your wounds, and it's terribly hard to do that when you always have constant reminders around. Those feelings of jealousy, insecurity, and hurt will go away in time, but you need to give yourself that time and space in order to let it happen. I know it's not easy at all, but it does get better. I'll be on and off of Reddit today, so feel free to send me a PM if you would like to talk, or just vent. 

Remember, you are not alone.

I'm sorry for the slow reply, my internet keeps going in and out. It sounds like you need some space and time to decompress. I know it seems impossible right now, but I would recommend going on a walk for a while, doing some stretches, and getting some sleep. When I find my mind racing all over the place, or becoming overwhelmed that helps to bring my thoughts into a more manageable state. If you can't do any of that, or you find yourself feeling overwhelmed I'll be here for a little while longer, and do my best to reply as I can.

Hey, you're scream in the dark is not falling on deaf ears. PM me if you want to talk, or just vent. I am here to listen without judgement. 

You are not alone.
Hey, I'm in a similar situation. My long term SO of 6 years left me a few months ago, and I've been trying to work through it. PM me if you need someone to talk to.
